Class UpdateMercuryTransactionsSchedulableTest

@IsTest()
private class UpdateMercuryTransactionsSchedulableTest

Tests for UpdateMercuryTransactionsSchedulable and the UpdateMercuryTransactionsQueueable it enqueues. Exercises the happy path (Mercury returns updated sent status), the catch-all exception path (via the queueable's throwTestException hook), the Mercury error response path, the database update failure path (invalid status picklist), and the no-pending-transactions short-circuit.

Change Log

  • 05/10/2026 - v1.3 - Extract shared test data initialization to @TestSetup method for reusability. Introduce getBankTransaction helper method to retrieve seeded data. Simplify Mercury response mock setup across test methods. Apply test conventions (TestFor, Assert.* migration); modernize ApexDoc; bump API to 66.0.

  Modifiers and Type Name Description
private static BankTransaction__c
getBankTransaction()
Returns the single seeded BankTransaction__c from @TestSetup, with all the fields the test bodies need to compose Mercury mock responses and assert the post-run state.
private static void
noPaymentsTest()
Verifies the schedulable short-circuits cleanly when no BankTransaction__c records are in BANKTRANSACTION_STATUS_ONGOING (no callouts, no DML, no errors).
private static void
setup()
Provisions the org-level settings the queueable depends on plus a single pending BankTransaction__c (with its own ACH recipient and an own Mercury source bank account) so each test starts with one in-flight transaction the schedulable can pick up.
private static void
updatePaymentDatabaseErrorTest()
Verifies that when Mercury returns an invalid Status__c picklist value, the failed Database.update call logs exactly one ErrorLog__c record.
private static void
updatePaymentExceptionTest()
Verifies that when UpdateMercuryTransactionsQueueable.throwTestException forces an exception, the catch-all path logs exactly one ErrorLog__c record and the schedulable completes.
private static void
updatePaymentServiceErrorTest()
Verifies that when Mercury returns a non-success response (HTTP 401), the queueable logs exactly one ErrorLog__c record and the schedulable completes.
private static void
updatePaymentTest()
Verifies the happy path: looks up the pending BankTransaction__c seeded by @TestSetup, mocks Mercury returning sent with a posted timestamp, runs the schedulable, and asserts the transaction's Status__c flips to sent.
